_comment: Pipeline settings that are not part of the story: models, seeds, characters, subtitles, music cues, export. The story itself is storyboard.json. src/validate.py merges the two.
negative_prompt: text, letters, writing, words, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, cartoon, illustration, anime, oversaturated, harsh shadows

params.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, extra fingers, flicker, text, watermark, fast motion

narration_settings.style_instruction: Gemini only (unused with Azure): warm, tender and unhurried, like a grown child paying tribute to their mother. Azure pacing is set by models.narration.params.

cues.caption: instrumental, soft piano with gentle Ethiopian instrumental atmosphere, tender soft strings, warm, peaceful, reflective, intimate, nostalgic
cues.purpose: Set a peaceful, reflective tone for her mornings and her love.

cues.caption: instrumental, gradually building emotional score, steady dignified rhythm, Ethiopian-inspired texture with soft masinko and krar, determined, resilient, calm
cues.purpose: Carry her determination and hard work without competing with the voice.

cues.caption: instrumental, hopeful rising piano melody, warm strings, uplifting, encouraging, sense of achievement and gratitude
cues.purpose: Lift as her sacrifice turns into the child's education and graduation.

cues.caption: instrumental, soft intimate piano and strings, emotional resolution, tender, gentle fade-out
cues.purpose: Resolve the tribute warmly and fade into the end card.

shot_02.subtitle_en: My strong mother, always up before dawn. Everything she did for us will never leave my heart.

shot_03.subtitle_en: The love she gave me, her advice, the hope she gave me, her calm… all of it lives in my heart as a precious memory.

shot_04.subtitle_en: To raise me and send me to school, there was no slope she did not go down, no hill she did not climb.

shot_05.subtitle_en: She never divided work into men's work and women's work. She did it all, tirelessly.

shot_06.subtitle_en: She spent many years herding sheep.

shot_07.subtitle_en: So that I could study from grade 1 to grade 12, and go on to university,

shot_08.subtitle_en: and even after I graduated, until I found work, she helped me in so many ways.

shot_09.subtitle_en: So often the weight of the family rested on her. Her love for her children, the tiredness she carried in silence…
shot_09.notes: keyframe_prompt overrides the story: the story asks for hands then a portrait, which the image model drew as a split image. Hands only here; split into two shots if the face is needed.
shot_09.keyframe_prompt: A single close-up photograph of the weathered hands of a hardworking Ethiopian mother with deep brown skin, resting in her lap after a long day, the edge of her white netela shawl visible, authentic rural environment, warm natural light, cinematic documentary style, one image, no split screen

shot_10.subtitle_en: My mother does not say much in words, but she showed me with her life. My strong mother… your love and your memory will never leave my heart.
shot_10.motion_prompt: Slow camera pull-back from the embrace, natural gentle movement.
shot_10.notes: motion_prompt overrides the story: fade to black, title and AI disclosure are added at assembly (end card), not generated by Wan.
